frase_gancho.texto: Fabrics that are thought: every embroidery is a way of writing.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: The last hall of the upper floor looks at textiles as a form of thought. Looms, huipiles, quechquémitls and rebozos are not just clothing: they hold symbols, knowledge and a way of seeing the world, and each people recognizes its own. You will see gala dress from the Isthmus and from Papantla, a red Triqui huipil, the patakua rebozo, the wool gabán of Chamula and the screens of Mathias Goeritz. Notice the technique, the color and the design: every stitch is a decision, and every design says which people the wearer belongs to.
